data.name: Ninja Monkey
targeting_extra: Caltrops/Sticky Bomb have own placement/targeting (Sticky: MOAB-class only; Paragon sticky always Strong)
data.crosspath_rule: Standard BTD6: one path to tier 5, a second path up to tier 2, third path locked at 0.

1.name: Ninja Discipline
1.text: All attack cooldowns -30% (~+42.85% attack speed). Shuriken cd 0.434s.

1.name: Double Shot
1.text: 2 shurikens per shot, 18 degrees apart, spread center randomly offset up to 5 degrees.

1.name: Bloonjitsu
1.text: 5 shurikens per shot (6 with Deadly Tranquility MK) over 45 degrees, random offset 5 degrees.

1.name: Grandmaster Ninja
1.text: 8 shurikens/shot (9 with MK) over 72 degrees, damage 1->2, cooldown 0.434->0.217s, range +10 (40->50), line of sight slightly elevated.

2.name: Distraction
2.text: Each attack has a chance (differs per attack) to send damaged bloons or their children backwards 100-150 units; Ceramics half distance (50-75); MOAB-class unaffected. Flash Bomb gets 30% chance with 0-1-3 (32.5% with Diversion Tactics MK); Sticky explosion 15% with 0-1-4 (17.5% MK), not blimps.

2.name: Counter-Espionage
2.text: All attacks strip Camo from bloons they damage; +2 damage to Camo (+4 for 5-2-0 shurikens and 0-2-3 Flash Bomb). Decamo occurs before damage so bonus only works on Phayze during Radar Jam. 0-2-4 Sticky Bomb also decamos DDTs.

2.name: Shinobi Tactics
2.text: Buffs all Ninjas in range including itself; attack cooldown -8% multiplicative and pierce +8% additive per stack, stacks to 20 per Ninja.

2.name: Bloon Sabotage
2.text: Ability: all bloons on screen and new spawns at half speed for 15s. Not BADs/Bosses; children of MOAB-class popped while slowed unaffected.

2.name: Grand Saboteur
2.text: Sabotage lasts 30s; instantly deals 25% health to all new MOAB-class (incl. BADs, not Bosses); buffs all on-screen Shinobi Ninjas +10 range and +2 MOAB damage while active. Slow effect now receives damage buffs and damages all bloons on screen/new spawns.

3.name: Seeking Shuriken
3.text: Range +7 (+17.5%); shurikens seek targets from any range with very fast turning.

3.name: Caltrops
3.text: Extra attack: places caltrops randomly on track in range (limited by LoS) every 3.9s; 1 sharp dmg, pierce 6, last 35s, vanish at round end.

3.name: Flash Bomb
3.text: Every 4th attack is a flash bomb: explodes on impact, radius 40, 3 Normal dmg (pops Black), pierce 30, stuns outer layer of non-MOAB bloons 1.3s. Shurikens +2 pierce, +4 dmg vs stunned.

3.name: Sticky Bomb
3.text: New attack: sticky bomb on MOAB-class only; detonates after 2.95s for 450 to target, plus explosion (100 dmg, pierce 10, radius 40); removed if target layer popped first. Won't target a bloon with same tier bomb. Shurikens +2 pierce, +4 vs stunned and vs any sticky bomb.

3.name: Master Bomber
3.text: Flash and sticky bombs stun MOAB-class (not BADs/Bosses); sticky thrown 2x as often, infinite range, 1s stun on attach, 3000 to target and 600 splash; flash bomb 10 dmg; shurikens +19 vs stunned and vs sticky; caltrops dmg 5 and +5 Ceramic.

paragon.name: Ascended Shadow
paragon.requirement: Ninja Monkeys with Grandmaster Ninja, Grand Saboteur and Master Bomber on map at once; absorbs other Ninjas; degree 1-100.
paragon.effect: Three attacks with bonus damage to Camo and Bosses, blowback chance 15% (100-150 units): 8 seeking shurikens at a time (9 with Deadly Tranquility), extra damage vs stunned/sticky-bombed; flash bombs 5 at a time (6 w/ MK) releasing 3 seeking mini-shurikens each (4 w/ MK), stun 2 layers regular bloons 3s, MOAB-class 1s; enchanted-card sticky bomb, infinite range, always Strong, explodes just under 3s. Passives: global Camo detection for all towers on screen (blockable by Radar Jam except Paragons), Grand Saboteur slow 50% + 25% MOAB layer health reduction (not Bosses), +10 range to all Ninjas on screen and +1 Shinobi stack to Ninjas in range. Exact damage/pierce numbers not captured.
